From visit to enquiry

What the website needs to generate leads

Agree what counts as a useful enquiry before the build. A form submission becomes meaningful when the team can review the request and see whether it fits the business.

A page for each important service

Explain the offer, area served, evidence of relevant work and next step. Search and advertising should take a visitor to the page that answers their request.

A form that reaches the right person

Ask for the details needed to assess the enquiry. Test mobile completion, validation, delivery and the confirmation message before launch.

Reporting tied to useful enquiries

Record completed enquiries and their landing pages where measurement allows. Review enquiry quality with the business, then decide which pages or campaigns need work.

What We Look After

Website, Google Ads and Search, Run by One Galway Team

A website on its own does very little for a local business. It earns its keep when the Google Ads point at the right pages, the search work brings people who were already looking, and someone reports every month on how many enquiries all of it produced.

The website

A Webflow build your own staff can edit, or an existing site taken over and looked after. Either way its job is enquiries, and how many it brought is in the monthly report rather than a mystery.

Google Ads

Campaigns set up, watched and adjusted continuously, so budget goes to the searches that turn into enquiries. The spend and the results sit in the monthly report beside everything else, and nothing runs unwatched.

Search visibility

Search engine optimisation and visibility in AI answers, run as one discipline. When someone in Galway asks Google or ChatGPT for what you sell, the work is making sure you are the answer they get.

One team, one report

The site, the ads and the search work depend on each other, so one team runs all three and one report each month says what they did. You have one number to call and one document to read.

A Galway Client

Stira: a Galway Manufacturer We Have Looked After for Years

Stira has made attic stairs in Dunmore since 1982.

They sell across Ireland and the UK, through the website and through direct enquiry. We run their Google Ads, look after their search engine optimisation and their visibility in AI answers, and take on the website work as it comes up.

We oversee Stira’s organic and paid search as one account.

Google Ads, search engine optimisation and visibility in AI answers, run together and reported together, so a Galway manufacturer selling across two markets has one team accountable for where its enquiries come from. That is what a local engagement with us looks like.

Who This Suits

Who We Work With in Galway

Most of our roster is B2B software companies in Ireland, the UK and the US. Locally, we take on a small number of businesses where the fit is right, and we say so plainly when it is not.

Established Galway businesses

Manufacturers, professional services, specialist trades and firms with a real customer base, where the website should be bringing enquiries and someone senior wants to know each month whether it did.

Businesses that want one supplier

If the site is with one company, the ads with another and nobody owns the search work, the three drift apart. We take all three, so there is one team to call and one report to read.

Who we are not right for

A five-page site for a few hundred euro, built in a week and never touched again. There are good studios in Galway for that and we will point you at them rather than quote for work we would not do well.

What we are honest about

We are not the cheapest option in the city. Being in Galway means we can meet in person and work your hours. The monthly report is where the work itself is judged, and it is the document you show whoever asks what the spend produced.
